# SPD-097 — Split Spud's home from the tool repository

## Brief
Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-16-home-tool-split-design.md, sections 1 to 5 and 7 to 9 (Eric approved the design in conversation on 2026-09-16). Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-16-home-tool-split.md, five phases of twenty tasks, with the switch-over runbook at its end.

Move Spud's home (the database, backups, config and the Obsidian vault: ledger/, reports/, docs/) out of the tool repository into ~/Personal/SpudHome, a plain directory that is not a git repository. The CLI finds the home through SPUD_HOME, then ~/.config/spud/home, and no longer through the git checkout it runs from. A LaunchAgent runs `spud render --watch`, so the vault follows the database within seconds and no ledger write needs git; `spud ledger commit` is retired. `spud home move --to <dir>` performs the switch-over and verifies it. ~/Personal/Spud becomes an ordinary project (key spud, sessions claim, landing merge) holding only the tool's code, tests and sources.

## Size, persona and model decision
Architectural and data-moving. Planned with writing-plans once Eric has reviewed the spec: expected one engineer (opus) building in a worktree of the tool repo, and a reviewer (fable) on spud home move, because a wrong move loses ledger data.

## Outcome
Built in worktree spd-097-home-split over five phases by Vitelotte (01, architect), Atlantic (02), Ratte (03), Charlotte (04), Amandine (05), Burbank (06) and Umatilla (07). The home resolves through SPUD_HOME and the ~/.config/spud/home pointer, never the checkout; the home is a synthetic row in the path rule, with home_roots() holding Law 5 over any project rooted at the home; project spud is an ordinary project and `ledger commit` is gone; a render that changes nothing writes nothing, takes a lock, and logs a conflict once per path and hash; `render --watch` under the LaunchAgent local.spud.render keeps the vault current, with doctor and board reporting a down watcher; and `spud home move --to <dir>` performs the switch-over, proving the copy by integrity check and row counts before trusting it.

Numbers at the merge: suite 939 tests, one error, the stray ledger/tickets/Untitled.md of SPD-100 only. Hook timing against main over 30 interleaved rounds: Bash +0.04, Write +0.30, SessionStart +0.05, Stop +0.15, board +0.68 ms, all inside the 1 ms budget, after repository_dir() removed a +13.36 ms cliff for linked worktrees. Synthetic render over 242 files: full pass 83 ms, no-change pass 55 ms. Module sizes: none at 1000, nothing created or grown past 350.
